description: Design reviewed schema additions (tenantId columns, foreign keys, indexes) with mixed-version consumer compatibility analysis where persistence cannot represent tenant ownership, prepare migration/rollback DDL without executing
steps: Read FEAT-001 findings: ownership-classification.md for identified schema gaps

Design tenantId additions to core schemas following Drizzle ORM patterns from existing files. Target schemas: packages/db-skillup/src/schema/users.ts (add tenantId text NOT NULL with index), packages/db-tutorial/src/schema/tutorial-progress.ts (add tenantId, change unique constraint from (userId, subtopicId) to (tenantId, userId, subtopicId)), packages/db-people/src/schema/placement-jobs.ts (add tenantId if placement profiles need tenant qualification per FND12 SD-26 to SD-30)

For export jobs: Identify current schema location (search for export_jobs or report_jobs table in packages/db/src/schema/). Add tenantId column with foreign key or text reference depending on tenant table location

Design backward compatibility: new tenantId columns must be nullable initially to support mixed-version deployments. Document transition states: null = pre-migration row, non-null = tenant-qualified row. Define quarantine query: WHERE tenantId IS NULL for unknown provenance

Design foreign key constraints: if tenant table exists (check packages/db-people or packages/db-skillup for tenants table), add FK references. If tenant is represented by platform enum only, use text column with check constraint matching platformEnum values

Design indexes: composite indexes on (tenantId, userId) for users table, (tenantId, userId, subtopicId) for tutorial_progress, (tenantId, jobId) for export jobs. Single-column index on tenantId for admin queries

Analyze consumer compatibility: List all files importing tutorial-progress.repository.ts, export download route, user.repository.ts. For each consumer, determine if it can handle nullable tenantId (read path) and must provide tenantId (write path). Document required service signature changes

Write migration DDL: Draft SQL ALTER TABLE statements for each schema change following Drizzle migration pattern (see existing migrations in packages/*/migrations/). Include: ADD COLUMN tenantId, CREATE INDEX, ADD CONSTRAINT. Mark as NOT FOR EXECUTION - requires Sol authorization
Write rollback DDL: Draft SQL to DROP constraints, DROP indexes, DROP columns. Include data preservation check: SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE tenantId IS NOT NULL before rollback

Document unknown provenance handling: Query to identify rows with NULL tenantId after migration grace period. Recommended action: QUARANTINE (move to shadow table) or DENY (access control rejects NULL tenantId reads)

Write schema proposal at .agents/tasks/fnd03-ownership-architecture/schema-changes.md with: Executive Summary, Affected Schemas (with before/after DDL), Foreign Key Design, Index Strategy, Backward Compatibility, Consumer Impact Analysis, Migration DDL (review-only), Rollback DDL, Unknown Provenance Strategy
acceptance_criteria: schema-changes.md contains reviewed DDL for tenantId additions to users, tutorial_progress, export jobs schemas
Backward compatibility strategy documented for nullable tenantId columns during mixed-version deployment
Consumer impact analysis lists all affected repositories and required signature changes
Migration DDL drafted but marked NOT FOR EXECUTION pending Sol authorization
Rollback procedure documented with data preservation checks
verification: grep 'ALTER TABLE.*ADD COLUMN tenantId' schema-changes.md (expect 3+ matches for users, tutorial_progress, export jobs)
grep 'NOT FOR EXECUTION\|requires Sol authorization' schema-changes.md (confirm execution gate documented)
